faces.name: Tivit, Seller of Secrets

triggered.raw_text: Whenever Tivit enters or deals combat damage to a player, starting with you, each player votes for evidence or bribery. For each evidence vote, investigate. For each bribery vote, create a Treasure token.

effects.text: starting with you, each player votes for evidence or bribery
For each bribery vote, create a Treasure token

static_abilities.raw_text: While voting, you may vote an additional time. (The votes can be for different choices or for the same choice.)
